title: Repair PR 47 CI regressions
summary: Repairs PR 47 CI regressions in strict pending-publish manifests, command-journal validation, WebView focus and rendering behavior, lint accounting, generated contracts, browser census evidence, and development dependency declarations.
reason: The pull request introduced stricter contracts and new WebView controls without synchronizing every manifest field, dependency, generated baseline, lint budget, and browser assertion. It also allowed oversized rejected command-journal scalars to reach expensive regex redaction.
behavior_before: Strict rerun manifests omitted output hash proof, oversized invalid journal requests could exceed the API timeout, quick-link focus was lost during queued refreshes, maintenance rendering assumed an array, and CI baselines and assertions did not match the new controls.
behavior_after: Strict rerun manifests include the already-computed SHA-256 proof, journal redaction receives bounded scalar text, quick-link focus stabilizes across queued refreshes, maintenance rendering safely handles absent rows, and CI dependencies, generated contracts, lint accounting, and browser assertions match the implemented behavior.
manual_validation: 158 targeted Python tests and 640 subtests passed
Command-journal timeout and policy tests passed: 19 tests and 27 subtests
Dependency boundary check passed with zero unallowlisted hard findings; 43 launch, snapshot, and priority-export tests plus 40 subtests passed
Direct ESLint verification reported no warnings for runMonitorView.js
Evidence and root control censuses passed; shell census uses an exact accepted split for timing-dependent controls
Home live-state browser smoke passed twice consecutively
Pending-publish, snapshot, topbar, and cross-page tests passed: 6 tests and 565 subtests
WebView asset syntax, generated map, DOM gap, routes, commands, script order, public contract, and touchpoint checks passed
npm run webview:prework:check passed at 1380/1387 warnings with zero errors; 107 focused WebView tests and 451 subtests passed
rollback_plan: Revert this change as one commit. No persisted state migration is required; pending manifests created after this change retain compatible additive hash fields.
notes:
Python impact is limited to bounding rejected command-journal scalar redaction and including existing output-hash evidence in a strict pending-publish manifest. No media policy, source mutation, route contract, or publish/drain decision changed. Representative real-media validation is not required because the pending-publish change is additive manifest evidence covered by hermetic contract tests. The full local WebView prework lint command was not treated as authoritative because the isolated worktree reuses a dependency tree from a dirty configured checkout and reports unrelated warnings absent from the clean GitHub Actions npm-ci run; targeted syntax, lint, contract, and browser checks were used instead.
PR-added process-to-queue imports were replaced by queue-service capability calls, preserving queue ownership and removing the new package-cycle edge.
Follow-up removes the clean-CI lint regressions by extracting low-complexity topbar helpers, removing dead timeline locals, moving stateless priority helpers outside the factory, and declaring the shared lastQueue binding writable.
